title: [Bittermere Woods]
description: The path terminates at a barrier of dying trees, their once vibrant orange canopies growing grey and brittle, while their bark flakes away in sheaves like scorched and crumbled pieces of parchment.  Inky scorpidium moss obscures the bare wood, tufts of old man's beard lichen drape from the branches, and the majority of the color comes not just from the crimson glow that can be glimpsed beyond the treeline, but the sparse clusters of satiny red pincushion moss found in patches among the other moss.
